name: re8ch-platform-observe
description: Read-only RE8CH platform inventory, health, metrics, logs, registry and security posture.

interface.longDescription: OAuth-protected, read-only access to RE8CH node and workload status, fixed metrics, log summaries, registry metadata, service health and security posture. It cannot read Secret values, kubeconfig, arbitrary SQL, or mutate Kubernetes resources.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inventory RE8CH platform health and summarize anything requiring attention.
